messages.author: User
messages.text: Esto no está preparado muy bien si hay muchos repos y muchos environments...

messages.author: overmind-hivem1nd
messages.text: Redone for many folders and repositories: the found repositories are grouped by the folder that holds them (Web 19, Unity 6, Tools 1), with a filter, one tick per folder and the repositories inside. Each folder becomes a cluster linked to it, with its repositories as clusters inside; worktrees stay inside their repository. New screens 1.3 All clusters and 1.4 Inside a folder cluster (double click opens it, All clusters goes back).

messages.text: Done: the notice offers Compact (keeps a summary) and Clear (starts empty); Keep going is gone and an X at the top right closes it.

messages.author: overmind-hivem1nd
messages.text: Drawn in 2.4: Runs in opens one picker with three columns, agent with its remaining quota, model and effort.

messages.author: overmind-hivem1nd
messages.text: Yes, the same one. Runs in opens the picker of 2.4 everywhere: here for the Overseer, in New agent, and in an agent's facts to change it later.
